paragraphs.text: T6 ageing was carried out at 175 C for 8 h; three specimens were tested per condition.
The T6 aged alloy reached a yield strength of 318 MPa, higher than the as-cast value of 210 MPa.
We conclude that T6 ageing improves strength at the cost of ductility.
Ductility was reduced after ageing, consistent with the hardness increase.
